_comment: Warehouse Outbound's rights (docs/warehouse_picking_PRD.md §4.7, §4.15; Q-W11), shipped as a library layer.
Two slots the application must bind (an unbound slot refuses startup): warehouse-outbound:pickers (read orders and
slots) and warehouse-outbound:supervisors (manual release, holds, batch takeover, consolidation slots).
Orders are read-only everywhere: the outbound services write them; the custom actions change them.
Owner-organization members read their own orders (@authenticated, narrowed by Organizations' row policy: WD3, WI5).
Opt out of all of these with "libraries": { "warehouse-outbound": false }.
